definitions.lateral compartment of leg muscle: A skeletal muscle organ that is part of the lateral (fibular) fascial compartment of the leg, comprising the fibularis longus and fibularis brevis muscles, both arising from the lateral surface of the fibula and innervated by the superficial fibular nerve, acting to evert and weakly plantarflex the foot.
